evidence:
frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/documents/components/MoveFolderDialog.tsx (802 lines, a Phase-1 churn hotspot) renders its entire user-facing UI as hardcoded Slovak string literals and never calls useTranslation/t(). grep count of t() usages in the file is 0, whereas sibling document components (FolderTree.tsx, DocumentUpload.tsx) do wrap text in t(). Hardcoded strings include: line 144 aria-label="Umiestnenie priecinka"; line 320 aria-label="Presunut dokumenty"; line 325

Presunut do priecinka

; line 326 aria-label="Zavriet"; line 353 Ciel:; line 368 Koren (bez priecinka); line 347 `${documentTitles.length} dokumentov` (also an untranslated hardcoded plural).

The app ships four locales (sk, cs, de, en per CLAUDE.md / react-i18next). Every string in this dialog is frozen to Slovak, so cs/de/en users see untranslated text and the plural form is uncountable/ungrammatical for other languages. This is a shipped, actively-churned move-documents flow, so the gap is user-visible in production.

Suggested fix: introduce useTranslation() and move all literals to the documents i18n namespace (e.g. documents.moveFolder.*), replacing the plural at line 347 with an i18n count-plural key. Note the app-wide RTL/pluralization implication -- do not just string-swap the Slovak text.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/documents/components/DocumentSharePanel.tsx has 0 useTranslation/t() calls and renders hardcoded ENGLISH user-facing strings: line 129

New share

; line 154 placeholder="uuid-of-user"; line 180 placeholder="e.g. manager"; line 189 "Password protect"; line 209 placeholder="Min. 4 characters"; line 238 "days"; line 292/304 "No active shares yet."; line 308 "Active shares"; line 415 "Share"; line 421 "Loading shares..."; line 422 "Could not load shares."

This is the same i18n-gap class as MoveFolderDialog but in the opposite language: the documents feature mixes hardcoded Slovak (MoveFolderDialog) and hardcoded English (DocumentSharePanel), so in a single Slovak-primary session the share panel appears entirely in English. All four supported locales (sk/cs/de/en) are affected. The placeholder "uuid-of-user" at line 154 is also raw dev-facing copy leaking into a shipped share form.

Suggested fix: add useTranslation() and migrate the CreateShareForm + share-list strings to the documents.share.* i18n namespace; replace the raw "uuid-of-user" placeholder with a localized, user-meaningful hint. The password min-length rule itself is fine (handleCreate at line 86 guards password.trim().length < 4).
